pos.personaBrief: Tite's Brazil had 70% vs Costa Rica and 58% vs Belgium, with a possession-based approach restored (Yahoo), counter-press to win the ball back (Coaches' Voice), and became cautious when leading.

pro.personaBrief: Short build-up through Coutinho, Neymar and Marcelo (Switzerland), Thiago Silva libero trial for passing out from the back, Casemiro as safe pivot; fast counter-press recoveries.

est.personaBrief: Defined 4-1-4-1/4-3-3 roles and zonal defence, but tight triangles on the left and Gabriel Jesus mobile, Neymar drifting inside, Willian wide.

lar.personaBrief: Tite adjusted to add width via Willian against low blocks, with tight left-side triangles and attacking full-backs early; play concentrated down the left with Neymar, Coutinho and Marcelo.

blo.personaBrief: Aggressive marking and counter-press to win the ball and come out playing, Gabriel Jesus pressing build-up, defensive line moved higher, high/mid/low press tailored to opponent.

mar.personaBrief: Cleber Xavier states zonal defence in open play and at set pieces is the basis for everything; few fouls.

pla.personaBrief: Tite said he would not change his ideals by opponent but adapted against low blocks (Renato dropped, Willian width) and became cautious when ahead; his model was imposed with versatile players.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic, rock-solid side (16 clean sheets in 21), cautious when leading, though pursued wins away; popular joga bonito label is press framing.

sis.personaBrief: Collective empowers the individual (Tite); everyone defends (Willian: defence begins in attack), but Neymar given a left-sided playmaker role.

jog.personaBrief: Technical midfield (Renato, Coutinho, Casemiro as passing pivot) combined with disciplined intensity; wins cleanly rather than tactical fouling.

bas.personaBrief: Tite turned to experienced players like Paulinho, Dani Alves, Thiago Silva and a stable lineup, built with players he knew.

lid.personaBrief: Charming, patient and attentive man-manager who explains why, uses Renato as on-pitch translator, but keeps clear structure and humility rules.
